name: Hotel Jerome, Auberge Collection
positioning: Historic downtown Aspen hotel on the National Register of Historic Places, with its own bars, a Michelin Guide Recommended restaurant and a boutique spa
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable downtown Aspen base with ski concierge and shuttle service
Guests drawn to Aspen's Western history and its bar scene

facts.text: Hotel Jerome is at 330 East Main Street in downtown Aspen, within walking distance of the city's shops, galleries, restaurants and nightlife.
Hotel Jerome is approximately three miles, or 15 minutes, from Aspen/Pitkin County Airport, and complimentary airport transportation is available on arrival by request.
Hotel Jerome was built by Jerome B. Wheeler in 1889 with the vision of emulating the great European hotels of the time.
Prospect is the restaurant at Hotel Jerome and is listed as Michelin Guide Recommended for 2026.
Prospect displays custom artwork by photographer David Yarrow.
Felix Roasting Co. at Hotel Jerome is its first location outside New York City.
Yarrow Spa has three private treatment rooms, a co-ed relaxation room and an individual steam shower for both men and women.
Yarrow Spa offers an Element Bar where guests choose their own botanicals and essences to create a custom blend.
Hotel Jerome has an on-property ski concierge, ski storage and complimentary shuttle service for the four Aspen Snowmass mountains.
The Residential Suites have a private elevator entrance, expansive outdoor patios, three bedrooms and over 2,000 square feet.

highlights.text: Hotel Jerome is part of the National Register of Historic Places.
J-Bar is a 19th century bar at the hotel where cowboys and miners once rode their horses through the doors.
J-Bar has an original Chinoiserie Chippendale till signed by every bartender who has worked there.
Bad Harriet is Hotel Jerome's intimate cocktail bar, set beneath the historic Aspen Times building and named after Harriet Wheeler, wife of Jerome B. Wheeler.

considerations.text: Hotel Jerome typically closes for a period in spring, so guests should confirm seasonal operating dates.
Pool and gym access at Hotel Jerome are exclusive to guests staying on property.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the exclusive Aspen market.
